newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling steady in quiet market.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling opened the week stable in quiet trading on Monday, commercial dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.94 against the dollar, unchanged from Friday. Against the pound, it was posted at a mean rate of 89.43 from 89.41.
"We're seeing very steady flows with both sides well-matched," one dealer said.
Dealers said without new market factors, they expected the unit to remain stable in the short term.
"Demand is still very low mostly because importers have backed out of the market temporarily," another dealer said.
Last week, the shilling eased marginally past the 54.90 level on central bank purchases in an unmatched market.
The money market was liquid. Overnight rates were quoted below 10 percent compared to 10-16 percent on Friday.
